system.description: The Sidereal touches the threads of fate binding a bureaucratic official and tangles them until the mandarin's authority becomes indecisive and paralyzed. The character must have a chance to study the target official for at least one scene. The Sidereal's player rolls (Manipulation + Bureaucracy) against the target's Dodge MDV. On a success, the target official becomes afflicted with an inability to make decisive rulings or take bureaucratic action for a number of weeks equal to the Sidereal's Essence. All official paperwork the mandarin touches seems to loop back upon itself, referrals go unresolved, and orders fall into committees without resolution.
